title: Planet SkySat True Color
description: Planet SkySat True Color imagery is a three-band RGB composite of the red, green, and blue bands from Planet Labs PBC's SkySat constellation, showing the surface as it would appear to the naked eye. SkySat satellites can revisit a location multiple times a day and collect imagery at approximately 50 cm per pixel (multispectral bands: blue 450-515 nm, green 515-595 nm, red 605-695 nm, NIR 740-900 nm). Each item is an individual scene stamped with its acquisition time. Access is provided through NASA's Commercial Satellite Data Acquisition (CSDA) Program; includes copyrighted material of Planet Labs PBC.
